build_DDRHead_instance: build a DDRHead decode head for DDRNet with specified input channels and number of classes
forward_DDRHead_training: run the DDRHead forward pass in training mode to get context and spatial segmentation logits
forward_DDRHead_inference: run the DDRHead forward pass in inference mode to get context segmentation logits only
init_weights_DDRHead: initialize DDRHead weights using Kaiming normal for conv layers and constant for batch norm
loss_by_feat_DDRHead: compute context and spatial segmentation losses along with accuracy metrics from segmentation logits
